elements.title: Code snippet for Monte Carlo simulation of decision tree accuracy
elements.details: Python code defining num_simulations=1000, initializing results list, looping through simulations with random train-test splits, training DecisionTreeClassifier models, predicting, calculating accuracy, appending results, and computing average accuracy. The print statement outputs average accuracy over 1000 simulations: 0.75.
elements.summary: This code snippet demonstrates how to perform Monte Carlo simulations to estimate the average accuracy of a decision tree classifier by repeatedly splitting data, training, predicting, and calculating accuracy.
